0.content: Aether and Lumine's Spaceship (also: the twins' spaceship, the Traveler's spaceship, Traveler's spaceship): The twins' spaceship is the vessel in which the Traveler and their sibling crossed the sea of stars before ever reaching Teyvat. It is a star-shaped craft of white and gold with a blue cockpit dome, made of a material nothing in Teyvat could scratch. It once lay overgrown at Starsand Shoal in Nod-Krai; after the Cataclysm the Heavenly Principles removed it and hid it on the Frost Moon, where Columbina brought the Traveler to find it (Welkin Moon's Homecoming, 6.3).

1.content:
Afterglow Cavern: Afterglow Cavern is a mountain cave in Wavechaser Plain, Nod-Krai, southeast of Favonius Keep. It was once a tunnel leading north, but it collapsed after a kuuvahki-related anomaly. Travellers know it mostly as the den of a large moonlight-loving gecko.

Status as of 7.1: As of 7.1 the northern tunnel remains collapsed and the cave is the Radiant Moongecko's lair.

2.content:
Aino's House (also: Ainos House, Aino and Ineffa's home): Aino's House is the home of the child inventor Aino and her robot Ineffa, set inside the Clink-Clank Krumkake Craftshop on Lempo Isle in Nod-Krai. It is an eclectic, colorful building made of scrap metal and creativity.

People: Aino and Ineffa live here.

Status as of 7.1: As of 7.1 it is simply Aino and Ineffa's home; the wiki records no change.

3.content:
Amsvartnir (also: Lake Amsvartnir): Amsvartnir is a lake in Wavechaser Plain, in northern Nod-Krai, lying north of the city of Piramida. A sacred forest grows beside it, beyond the ruins of an ancient palace and on the edge of the wasteland. Above the water, hidden from mortal eyes by day, stands the Royal Court of the Seelie, where Koitar, the first of the Seelie, was once confined.

Status as of 7.1: As of 7.1 the Royal Court stands restored and open to visitors, and the Seelie gather there.

4.content: Archaeolune Storm Research Center (also: Land of Raging Storms): The Archaeolune Storm Research Center is an ancient dragon facility on the Frost Moon whose job was to watch Archaeolune storms, surges of moon energy that sweep the surface. Today it lies in an Archaeolune Energy disturbance zone, and a terminal there holds a researcher's anxious notes about where the storms came from.

5.content:
Ashveil Peak: Ashveil Peak is the northernmost area of Pohjola, the large island of northern Nod-Krai, added in 6.3. It is a harsh, cold highland of cliffs under dark clouds. Its two subareas are Kipumaki Cliff, a hotspot of Wild Hunt activity where an undying Abyssal fiend was sealed long ago, and Cliffwatch Camp, the Lightkeepers' outpost that stands guard over it.

Status as of 7.1: As of 7.1 the cliff is open to explore; the sealed fiend has been defeated and its influence cleansed, but the Wild Hunt remains a danger in the north.

6.content:
Barrowmoss Barrens: Barrowmoss Barrens is a subarea of Lempo Isle in Nod-Krai: two plateaus lying north and south of Blue Amber Lake. It is a wild, open stretch where researchers and treasure hunters carry out odd projects, and where a Radiant Moonfly roams as a boss.

Status as of 7.1: As of 7.1 the Barrens remain an open, explorable area of Nod-Krai with nothing new revealed after the 6.x quests.

7.content: Big Bad Battle Base: The Big Bad Battle Base is an encampment on Lempo Isle in Nod-Krai that the young inventor Aino set up to run the Clink Clank Clash, a limited-time event of version 6.0. It was the working base for a string of odd jobs: testing a self-defence gadget, chasing runaway recon robots and tracking down lost experimental machines. Thin canon: the wiki gives little more than its map description and a list of three clients.

8.content:
Blue Amber Lake: Blue Amber Lake is a highland lake on a raised plateau of Lempo Isle in the Southern Isles of Nod-Krai, between the north and south sections of Barrowmoss Barrens. Its unusual climate gives it an ethereal glow at every hour of the day, and it is the only place where Stellafruit grows. Travellers rest at its shoreside bonfires, and the inventor known as Papa Wrench once built a workshop beneath it.

Status as of 7.1: As of 7.1 the lake is a peaceful stop on Lempo Isle, and Papa Wrench's workshop lies open under it.

9.content: Bubble Pool: The Bubble Pool is a lake subarea in the Lunar Highlands of the Frost Moon, in Nod-Krai. It was added with the Frost Moon in version 6.7 (Luna VIII). Canon says almost nothing about it beyond its name and an in-game viewpoint titled "The Iridescent Lake".

10.content:
Chasm of Endless Decay (also: Dawn Over the Dark Chasm): The Chasm of Endless Decay is a cave beneath Kipumaki Cliff in Ashveil Peak, Nod-Krai. Five hundred years ago Solovei, the Torchforger, and Aila, the first Moonchanter of the Frostmoon Scions, imprisoned the Abyssal Scourge of Endless Decay here. In the quest When War Songs Rise, Illuga and his squad return to finish what they began.

Status as of 7.1: As of 7.1 the Scourge of Endless Decay is dead and the chasm is cleansed.

11.content:
Cliffwatch Camp: Cliffwatch Camp is a Lightkeepers' outpost on Ashveil Peak in northern Nod-Krai, built by the Nightmare Orioles investigation squad to keep watch on the Abyssal activity at nearby Kipumaki Cliff. It has a lighthouse, a fortified perimeter, Moonwagons, a Statue of the New Moon at its entrance and a small cemetery to the south. It is a working post, busy and short of hands.

Status as of 7.1: As of 7.1 Cliffwatch Camp is a fortified, functioning Lightkeepers outpost; its original threat has been defeated.

12.content:
Clink-Clank Krumkake Craftshop (also: Krumkake Craftshop, Clinky, Clanky Craftshop, Clink-Clank Krumkake Workshop): The Clink-Clank Krumkake Craftshop is a huge, rusty, scrap-metal workshop on the outskirts of Nasha Town, on Lempo Isle in Nod-Krai. Aino, a child prodigy, started it to build the world's best krumkake machine, and it became famous as a machine workshop through her many inventions. She lives there with her robot Ineffa, and the air smells of machine oil, metal and krumkakes.

People: Aino, the founder, and Ineffa, the all-purpose household robot she built, live and work here.

Status as of 7.1: As of 7.1 the craftshop is open and in use as Aino's workshop and home. The wiki records no change to it after its introduction.

13.content: Crab Tsar's Palace (also: The Crab Tsar's Palace): The Crab Tsar's Palace is an underground cavern on Hiisi Island in Nod-Krai, home to the Crab Tsar, an enormous and normally gentle crab. The Traveler reaches it through a deep pit just west of the Frostmoon Enclave while helping Maite Veliu, a self-styled master thief, hunt a cursed stone that had changed the crab's temper. Rock Crabs live in its passages.

14.content: Curtain-Form Blackbody Containment Lab (also: Curtain-Form Blackbody Containment Laboratory): The Curtain-Form Blackbody Containment Lab is an ancient research site in the Moontide Sea on the Frost Moon. Here Professor Maagees's team learned that Moonshade Trees fused with "Blackbody Matter" and stimulated with Archaeolune Energy could throw off reflective waves that formed a curtain-like barrier. That was the first stage of Project Lunar Veil, a plan to hide the moon.

key: far side of the Frost Moon
15.content: Dark Side of the Moon (also: far side of the Frost Moon, the Dark Fortress, Darkside Base): The Dark Side of the Moon is the half of the Frost Moon that never faces Teyvat. Dragon researchers built a hidden base here as part of Project Moongazer. Later the Dragon Lord of Darkness, Nibelung, returned from the stars and reforged the moon into a weapon: the far side became a cannon drawing on the lunar core, aimed at Teyvat. The Heavenly Principles defeated him, and the weapon is dormant. Visitors reach it through the Project Moongazer quests (6.7).

16.content:
Dreadshade Mire: Dreadshade Mire is a fog-shrouded swamp in the Voidsea Outlook area of Nod-Krai. Solovei, the Torchforger, and Aila, the first Moonchanter of the Frostmoon Scions, used three ancient stone seals there to imprison the Serpent of All Evils. Wild Hunt creatures roam the fog, and the Lightkeepers' signboards at the mire's edge warn that entry is not advised.

Status as of 7.1: As of 7.1 the three pillars are restored and the Serpent of All Evils is defeated, but the mire is still fog-bound and dangerous.

17.content:
Dunanna Forward Station (also: Dunanna Station): Dunanna Forward Station is a buried installation under Dunanna Pit, an area of Nod-Krai near Fontaine and east of Pohjola. It is an old moon-landing base that includes a chamber for computing the orbits of the Three Moons, a generator room and a Main Control Hall, and it launches a lunar shuttle. It appears in the world quest Pioneers (Version 6.7).

Status as of 7.1: After Pioneers the station is working and its shuttle has left with the Traveler's party. Nothing after 7.1 is recorded.

18.content:
Dunanna Pit: Dunanna Pit is a mist-covered, island-like area of Nod-Krai added in 6.7 (Luna VIII), lying close to Fontaine and east of Pohjola. Its centre is Dunanna Forward Station, a half-buried ruin of a vanished civilisation with a huge mechanism and a chamber holding a spaceship. It is where the Moon Gazing quests start and where the road to the Frost Moon opens.

Status as of 7.1: As of 7.1 the area is simply open to explore. No later change to it is recorded.

19.content: The Eye of Ibni-Belum (also: Eye of Ibni-Belum, the Moongazers' tower, Silent Barrens): The Eye of Ibni-Belum is a tower-like dragon station on the Frost Moon. The dragon pioneer Ibni-Belum, called the First Moongazer, built it after receiving a mysterious signal from deep space that he took to be from Nibelung, hoping to hear it again. When it never came, the researchers turned it into a lunar surface monitoring station. In 6.7 the Traveler and Eggie reactivate it, and in the end Eggie uses it as the antenna to send the dragons' message back out into the stars.

20.content:
Eye of Kratti (also: Beneath the Forsaken Sea): The Eye of Kratti is a small island off Lempo Isle in Nod-Krai, with a crystalline tree growing at its centre. It was once a whirlpool of the same name that became a forbidden zone because of its turbulent waters, rumours of monsters including the Kratti it is named for, and the many people who vanished in it. The wrecked ship Atlas lies here with many others.

Status as of 7.1: As of 7.1 the whirlpool is gone and the island with its restored tree stands in its place.

21.content: False Moon Institute (also: Memories: Twilight of the Heretic): The False Moon Institute is a Trounce Domain in Nod-Krai, set at the Special Territory Research Institute in the far north of Ashveil Peak. It is a Fatui research facility, and the domain lets the Traveler relive the battle against the Heretic of the False Moon, the Fatui Harbinger the Doctor. The domain is presented as a memory of a fight over the fate of Nod-Krai, which was won by people standing together to defend their homeland.

22.content:
Favonius Keep: Favonius Keep is the Knights of Favonius' camp in Nod-Krai, on Wavechaser Plain. It is the base of Grand Master Varka's long expedition from Mondstadt: tents, a command tent with a meeting point, and a small garrison that gathers intelligence on the Wild Hunt and other Abyssal threats. It is deliberately modest and a little scruffy, and it smells of Mondstadt dandelion wine whenever a shipment has come in.

Status as of 7.1: As of 7.1 the Keep is a small Knights of Favonius garrison in Nod-Krai that Varka still uses; most of the expedition has returned to Mondstadt.

23.content:
Final Night Cemetery (also: Light of Oaths Sworn): The Final Night Cemetery is a graveyard around a lighthouse on Paha Isle, in Nod-Krai. It was once an active outpost of the Lightkeepers (Ratniki). Several decades ago a fight with the Wild Hunt put out the lighthouse's light and killed most of the garrison, and the survivors buried their dead here. Flins, a Ratnik, now lives alone on the island, together with many ghosts of fallen Lightkeepers.

Status as of 7.1: As of 7.1 Flins lives and keeps watch at the Final Night Cemetery's lighthouse.

24.content:
The Flagship (also: The Flagship tavern): The Flagship is the rowdiest tavern in Nasha Town, Nod-Krai. Drifters, treasure hunters and bounty hunters gather there to swap intel and pick up commissions, and the bartender Demyan runs it with a cheerful, lively air. It also rents rooms: the Traveler stays here in the Song of the Welkin Moon story.

People: Demyan is the bartender; the staff and regulars include recruiters, hosts and wandering travelers.

Status as of 7.1: As of 7.1 the tavern is open and doing good business. Nothing in 7.0 or 7.1 content changes it.

25.content:
Frost Moon: The Frost Moon is the second of Teyvat's Three Moons, which the dragon king Nibelung created. It is the brightest of them and the only one that survived the war of funerary flame. The Heavenly Principles banished it beyond the false sky, where its goddess Canon faded and died. For thousands of years Teyvat saw only a fake "shadowmoon" in its place. In True Moon (6.3) the real Frost Moon was pulled back inside the false sky, and Columbina, its new Moon Goddess, became the Trilune Goddess. It is now a reachable lunar world, full of ruins left by ancient dragon researchers.

Status as of 7.1: As of 7.1 the Frost Moon is back inside the false sky and visible over Teyvat again. Columbina reigns over it as the Trilune Goddess. She lives on Hiisi Island and travels freely between Nod-Krai and the moon. The shadowmoon is gone. The Moongazers' message was transmitted again in Moon Gazing. The Snezhnaya Archon Quest (7.0-7.1) adds nothing new about the moon.

26.content: Frostladen Machinery: Frostladen Machinery is a Domain of Blessing on Paha Isle in Nod-Krai, in the Maroon Basin. Its in-game description calls it a once-rumbling experimental outpost of colossal machines, built, used and then abandoned for the sake of ever grander visions. Now the goal feels close, the outpost's service is over and its devices sleep in cold silence.

27.content:
Frostmoon Enclave: The Frostmoon Enclave is the village-like home of the Frostmoon Scions, the moon-worshipping tribe of Nod-Krai, on forested Hiisi Island. It is a calm, book-filled place with a Grand Library, animals wandering freely, priestesses in quiet debate, and the Moonchanter Lauma at its centre. The Scions revere the Frost Moon and, since 6.3, the Moon Goddess herself lives among them.

Status as of 7.1: As of 7.1 the Enclave is at peace. Columbina lives here among the Scions, Lauma still leads them, and the Fatui have apologised.

28.content: Golden Hall (also: the great golden house, The Boatman's Song-House): The Golden Hall is a small site in the Lunar Highlands of the Frost Moon. Its map marker reads like an invitation to board a silver ship and return to the great golden house, and its readable text, the Chanson of the Boatman, is a prayer written by a boatman who served a night goddess.

29.content:
Hiisi Island: Hiisi Island is a forested island in the Southern Isles of Nod-Krai (accessible from 6.0). It is the home of the Frostmoon Scions, a religious sect devoted to the Moon Goddess, and under their care much of it is untouched wilderness. Its Frostmoon Enclave and the sealed Sanctum of the Oathbearer are the heart of their faith.

Status as of 7.1: As of 7.1 the island remains the Scions' home, open to explore, and the Sanctum has been unsealed.

30.content:
Idol of the New Moon (also: Statue of Kuutar): The Idol of the New Moon is a large statue on Hiisi Island, in the Light-Bathed Platform area, depicting the Moon Maiden Kuutar. According to the quests Where the Moon Rises and Hidden in the Shadows, it was carved five hundred years ago by Aila, the Moonchanter, from ore rich in kuuvahki.

Status as of 7.1: As of 7.1 the idol stands with wings, if The Homebound Moon has been completed.

31.content: Interstice of the Nearing Moon (also: Engraving, the orbital positioning facility): The Interstice of the Nearing Moon is a hidden instance reached by riding a Moonlane, a path of moonlight, from a kuuhenki behind the Idol of the New Moon on Hiisi Island. In the World Quest Echoes of an Unfinished Past (6.0) it appears as the strange route Verna leads the Traveler and Paimon down while trying to break the seal on the Court of the First Edict. It is in fact an old orbital positioning facility of the dragons, which they call Engraving.

32.content: Kalag Guarding Grounds: The Kalag Guarding Grounds is a security area in Ungien's Circle, the biosphere on the Frost Moon. It is named for Kalag, the moon's Security Chief. A Local Legend automaton, Mushteshir, can be fought here after two combat challenges.

33.content:
Kipumaki Cliff (also: Kipumaki): Kipumaki Cliff is a cliff in northern Nod-Krai, perpetually shrouded in dark clouds. It is said to hold a sealed, undying fiend: the Scourge of Endless Decay, an Abyssal entity that Aila (the first Moonchanter of the Frostmoon Scions) and Solovei (the Torchforger) subdued here 500 years ago. The area has been a hotspot of Wild Hunt activity ever since, and the Lightkeepers watch it from Cliffwatch Camp.

Status as of 7.1: As of 7.1 the seal has been restored and the Scourge of Endless Decay defeated, but Wild Hunt pressure on the cliff has not ended and the Lightkeepers still hold the line.

34.content:
Kuuvahki Experimental Design Bureau (also: Design Bureau, Experimental Design Bureau): The Kuuvahki Experimental Design Bureau is the Fatui's enormous steel-and-stone research and arms complex on Paha Isle, in the Southern Isles of Nod-Krai. The Expedition text calls it a colossal structure whose bulk is an unsubtle declaration of power and control. It studies kuuvahki, the moon-derived energy found only in Nod-Krai, and co-developed war machines, notably the Landcruisers, with Snezhnaya's Armory Palace. Sandrone (Marionette) oversaw its construction and ran it during the Nod-Krai crisis; Poruchik Raskolnikov keeps order there. Locals, especially the Frostmoon Scions, resent it.

Status as of 7.1: As of 7.1 the Bureau remains a Fatui facility in Nod-Krai, now with a tense peace with the Frostmoon Scions.

35.content:
Lempo Isle: Lempo Isle is one of the three Southern Isles of Nod-Krai, accessible from 6.0. It is home to Nasha Town, the region's main port and commercial centre, and to the Clink-Clank Krumkake Craftshop where the young inventor Aino works. Its settlements are crowded, industrial and run by no single authority.

Status as of 7.1: As of 7.1 Lempo Isle is open to explore; Nasha Town remains Nod-Krai's trading hub.

36.content:
Light-Bathed Platform: The Light-Bathed Platform is a subarea of Hiisi Island, the home of the Frostmoon Scions in Nod-Krai. It is the final destination of the pilgrimage route where wishes are offered to Lady Kuutar, the Moon Maiden, before the great Idol of the New Moon. A sealed sanctum, the Court of the First Edict, lies beneath a huge edifice nearby.

Status as of 7.1: As of 7.1 the Idol stands winged, the Court has been opened, and the platform remains a place of prayer.

37.content: Lightless Capital: The Lightless Capital is a Domain of Mastery on Lempo Isle in Nod-Krai: the corpse of a once-prosperous city that later fell into ruin. Hundreds of years ago Nod-Krai had its own golden age, and this city carried humanity's arrogant dreams at the edge of the world, with steel sinews and iron bones reflecting industrial and technological glory. Then calamity descended and the city was dragged into darkness and buried by time.

38.content: Lost Mooncourt: Lost Mooncourt is a Domain of Forgery on Hiisi Island in Nod-Krai. By its in-game text, the Frostmoon Scions once used the place as a sacrificial site and raised a lunar court here, hoping to summon lost moonlight back, but now only desolation and frozen silence remain. Weapon-enhancement materials are earned here.

39.content: Lunar Highlands (also: Highlands of the Frost Moon): The Lunar Highlands is the main stretch of the Frost Moon open to explore: a pale, low-gravity upland scattered with ruined facilities left by the ancient dragon researchers of Project Moongazer. It includes the Eye of Ibni-Belum, Ungien's Circle (a living biosphere), the Archaeolune Storm Research Center, the Nuur Stone Circle, the Golden Hall and Traveler's Crater, where the Traveler's spaceship rests. The moon opened to travellers in 6.7 through the Moon Gazing quests.

40.content:
Lusalim's Laboratory (also: Lusalim's research lab, Lusalim's final facility): Lusalim's Laboratory is the dragon researcher Lusalim's final workplace, tucked deep inside the vast hidden base on the Dark Side of the Moon in the Frost Moon (Nod-Krai). Its terminals hold his farewell: he confesses that he sinned against dragonkind by bowing to the Heavenly Principles, and he entrusts the last step of Project Moongazer to Nin-Kiggia (Ninnin), the data-born "daughter" he created.

Status as of 7.1: As of 7.1 the laboratory is intact and unattended inside the Dark Side base on the Frost Moon; its records stand as Lusalim's last testament.

41.content: Lusalim's Lunar Veil Laboratory (also: Lunar Veil Laboratory): Lusalim's Lunar Veil Laboratory is what is left of a hidden laboratory in the Moontide Sea, where the dragon researcher Lusalim carried on Project Lunar Veil after his teacher Maagees fell ill and Kalag's security force took control of the biosphere. It is unlocked in the Moontide Sea by repairing the High-Speed Transit Station.

42.content: Maagees's Greenhouse (also: Maggie's Greenhouse): Maagees's Greenhouse is a greenhouse in Ungien's Circle, the biosphere of the Frost Moon, reached by an elevator. It belonged to the dragon researcher Maagees and held Containment Object-1, a black specimen that began sending a message once shown starfield footage. Its terminal logs tell how the research broke down.

43.content:
Main Control Hall: The Main Control Hall is the central control room of Dunanna Forward Station, an underground installation in the Dunanna Pit area of Nod-Krai. The in-game map marker describes it as the core processing room for every command the station receives and transmits.

Status as of 7.1: As of 7.1 the hall remains part of the explorable Dunanna Forward Station; the sources read record no later change.

44.content:
Maroon Basin: Maroon Basin is a wide beach of distinctive pink stones on Paha Isle in Nod-Krai. It was once a thriving habitat for Tassel Jellies, but the Fatui's activity on the island has left it barren.

Status as of 7.1: As of 7.1 the basin is described as barren of Tassel Jellies; no later change is recorded in the sources read.

45.content:
Mimisbrunnr Books: Mimisbrunnr Books is a bookshop in Nasha Town, on Lempo Isle in Nod-Krai. It is owned by Dhabit and sells books.

Status as of 7.1: Operating in Nasha Town as of 7.1; no change recorded.

46.content:
Misty Shoal: Misty Shoal is a small island subarea of Dunanna Pit in Nod-Krai, east of Piramida, introduced in version 6.7. The sky above it is perfectly clear: there are no clouds at all. Beneath it lie ruins linked to a moon-landing project.

Status as of 7.1: As of 7.1 the island is explorable and the base's story continues in Moon Gazing content; nothing here is described as resolved.

47.content: Moonchild's Treasures: Moonchild's Treasures is a Domain of Blessing on Ashveil Peak in Nod-Krai, the sacred vault of a ruined tower. By the domain's text, descendants of the far north raised the tower for followers of the morning star, as a sign of resolve to resist fate and the will of the gods. Priests of the Moonchildren hid the last sparks of an ancient civilization's splendor here. Villains and owls now infest the ruin.

48.content:
Moongazer (also: the Moongazer spaceship, The Fallen Moongazer, Moongazer Log): The Moongazer is the spaceship the dragon researcher Ungien built to chase a mysterious deep-space signal. He flew it out across the sea of stars and vanished; years later it crashed, cloaked, into the Space Lifeform Capture Station on the Frost Moon, carrying a round black spiky creature that was all that remained of him. Its wreck still lies beside the station.

Status as of 7.1: As of 7.1 the Moongazer is a derelict wreck beside the Space Lifeform Capture Station; no one is shown repairing or flying it.

49.content:
Moonheart Gap (also: Moonheart Chasm, the moon's core, Heart of the Moon): The Moonheart Gap is the fissure at the bottom of the Frost Moon's Dark Side base that opens onto the moon's core, the source of its power. The dragon king Nibelung, returned from the stars and corrupted by the Abyss, tapped it to power a weapon that would fire the moon at Teyvat; earlier, the dragon researcher Lusalim used the core to gather the data of the Moongazers for rebirth.

Status as of 7.1: As of 7.1 the weapon is stopped and the core is quiet; the gathered researcher data is preserved.

50.content:
Moontide Sea (also: lunar sea, Sea of Broken Skies): The Moontide Sea is a lunar sea on the Frost Moon, a body of liquid-like Archaeolune Energy so dense that it can harm any living being that is not a kuuhenki. It formed after a terrible calamity wrecked Lusalim's Lunar Veil Laboratory; it is home to the Mega Kuuhenki Maggie and Ungie and to shoals of small kuuhenki that can mimic jellyfish and whales.

Status as of 7.1: As of 7.1 the sea is calm after the Fount's removal and the Mega Kuuhenki's reconciliation, though its energy remains dangerous.

51.content:
Nasha Town (also: Nasha): Nasha Town is the main port and commercial centre of Nod-Krai, on Lempo Isle. It has no official government. Merchants, adventurers, exiles, treasure hunters and Fatui all rub shoulders there, and the Voynich Guild and the Curatorium of Secrets do the most to keep it working. It is built largely of scrap metal, and kuuvahki-powered machines and cargo rails fill the sky above it.

Places: The Flagship tavern, Speranza restaurant, the Adventurers' Guild in the central plaza, the Voynich Guild and the Curatorium of Secrets, the port, and a handful of shops.

People: Residents include Nefer and Jahoda of the Curatorium, Katya of Speranza, Demyan of the Flagship, and the stray children of the Conch Gang. Ineffa and Aino of the Clink-Clank Krumkake Craftshop are frequent visitors.

Status as of 7.1: As of 7.1 Nasha Town stands, recovered after the siege. It remains a free port with no formal ruler, and the new League of factions first met there.

52.content:
North Harbor: The North Harbor is one of two harbors serving the Kuuvahki Experimental Design Bureau on Paha Isle in Nod-Krai. A posted notice says its operation is suspended and cargo is rerouted to the South Harbor.

Status as of 7.1: Closed to operations by notice as of the version read; goods go through the South Harbor. The sources read record no reopening by 7.1.

53.content: Northern Training Ground (also: Vaino's training ground): The Northern Training Ground is a small obstacle-and-target course on Lempo Isle in Nod-Krai, built by Vaino, a thirty-four-year-old former treasure hunter who has retired to run it. It offers light challenges such as shooting targets and dodging, and it has become tangled up with a cave of target-stealing Sniffer Moles the local children call the Hollowhands.

54.content:
Northland Bank (Nod-Krai) (also: Northland Bank Nasha Town branch, Nasha Town Northland Bank): This is the Nasha Town branch of the Northland Bank, the Snezhnayan bank with branches around Teyvat. It is managed by Jarosznski. From the outside it looks unremarkable, but its inside is a fortress of defenses and alarms.

People: Jarosznski is the manager. Drahomira, Kamenka and Kudratov, an agent, also work here.

Status as of 7.1: As of 7.1 the branch remains open in Nasha Town, with Jarosznski as manager.

55.content:
Nothing Passage: Nothing Passage is a narrow mountain pass cutting through the northern end of Lempo Isle in Nod-Krai. A whole Fatui company, the 6th, was wiped out here after dubious experiments by two rival researchers of the Armory Palace; only one private, Smirnova, escaped. After the world quest series Colors of Emptiness the entire passage becomes a strong kuuvahki environment.

Status as of 7.1: As of 7.1 the Fatui presence is gone from the passage, the dead company remains a mystery to the Fatui archive, and the pass sits as an eerie kuuvahki-saturated place.

56.content:
Nuts 'N' Nuts: Nuts 'N' Nuts is a combined grocery and repair shop in Nasha Town, Nod-Krai, run by Cairuo and Lestocq.

Status as of 7.1: Operating as of 7.1; no change recorded.

57.content:
Nuur Stone Circle (also: Ia-Ilimmu Storage Array, Silent Stone Circle): Nuur Stone Circle is an ancient dragon facility on the Frost Moon, in the Lunar Highlands, that records and stores the dragon researchers' data. Its tablets, once repaired, preserve notes about Project Moongazer, the Moongazers' backup research, and the plan to engrave a researcher's hopes into a data-born life that became Nin-Kiggia.

Status as of 7.1: As of 7.1 the circle is a quiet ruin whose array can be repaired and read.

58.content:
Paha Isle: Paha Isle is an island in the Southern Isles of Nod-Krai, accessible from 6.0. Once an unremarkable island known for sunset-hued salt marshes and Tassel Jellies, it changed when the heaviest fragment of the fallen moonstone crashed on its shores. It is now a staging ground for Fatui personnel in Nod-Krai, who work from the huge Kuuvahki Experimental Design Bureau, and it also holds the Lightkeepers' abandoned Final Night Cemetery.

Status as of 7.1: As of 7.1 the island remains open to explore, with the Fatui complex still standing and Flins posted at the cemetery.

59.content: Path of Misery (also: Beneath Kipumaki): The Path of Misery is a large winding cavern under Kipumaki Cliff in Ashveil Peak, in far northern Nod-Krai. It funnels down into the Chasm of Endless Decay, the pit where the Abyssal Scourge of Endless Decay was sealed five hundred years ago and where it was finally destroyed in the world quest When War Songs Rise.

60.content:
Pillar of Embla (also: Embla Pillar, Tower Piercing at the Sky): The Pillar of Embla is a great divine pillar in Wavechaser Plain in northern Nod-Krai, rooted in the earth and rising toward the sky. It was raised about five hundred years ago, during the Cataclysm, by Rauthvangi (known at the Belyi Tsar's court as Rotwang) as a tower to reach the false sky and carry him to his "Elysium", the Abyss. In the centuries since, its presence has permanently altered the surrounding land.

Status as of 7.1: As of 7.1 the Pillar of Embla is open to exploration. Rotwang's threat from it was ended in the Nightingale's Song chapter.

61.content:
Piramida: Piramida is the city of the Lightkeepers, Nod-Krai's volunteer militia against the Wild Hunt. It stands on a mountain around a giant golden-age lighthouse and is a garrison town of Ratniki: soldiers' lodgings, an infirmary, a forge, a plaza with a bulletin board, a great mead hall at the top, and a towering statue of the Torchforger, Solovei. It is proud, short of people, and run on stubborn hope.

Status as of 7.1: As of 7.1 Piramida is the Lightkeepers' working headquarters, still understrength but hopeful after destroying the Scourge in 6.3.

62.content:
Pohjola: Pohjola is the large northern island of Nod-Krai, lying north of the Southern Isles. It is made up of Voidsea Outlook in the south, Wavechaser Plain and Ashveil Peak in the north and, by the wiki's grouping, Dunanna Pit. The Lightkeepers' city Piramida stands on it, and the frontier's abyssal and Wild Hunt dangers are felt here. Its name is borrowed from the cold northern land of Finnish mythology.

Status as of 7.1: As of 7.1 Pohjola is open for travel and exploration, and the Lightkeepers hold it against the dark.

63.content:
"Post-Apocalyptic Elysium" (also: Bunker No. 0): "Post-Apocalyptic Elysium" is a bunker in Wavechaser Plain, Nod-Krai, built in the reign of the Belyi Tsar to survive the supposed destruction of the world. Its researchers lived there believing the Abyss had devastated everything outside; their supervisor, Morozov, secretly served the plotter Rotwang.

Status as of 7.1: As of 7.1 the bunker is open and its monster destroyed. Grazina's fate is recorded as sealing herself inside about 500 years ago.

64.content: Reed Miller's Great Treasure (also: The Great Treasure, The Final Treasure Site, Elysium's Final Treasure): Reed Miller's Great Treasure is a hidden cave beneath Dreadshade Mire in Nod-Krai, holding a huge pile of Iron Coins heaped on a ship. In folklore it is the great hoard of Reed Miller, the Treasure Hoarders' legendary master thief. In truth it was arranged about 500 years ago by Brahe, the third man to use that alias, as part of a plan to bury the real Reed Miller under harmless tall tales. The Traveler finds it by collecting the five Proofs of the Cognoscenti.

65.content:
Rossum Workshop: The Rossum Workshop is a smithy in Nasha Town, Nod-Krai. The blacksmith Arkhyp owns it, and his daughter Lyulka currently runs it.

Status as of 7.1: Operating as of 7.1; no change recorded.

66.content:
Royal Court of the Seelie (also: Royal Court of the Seelies, Palaces of Times Bygone, pale temple of Koitar): The Royal Court of the Seelie is a pale temple hidden above Lake Amsvartnir in Nod-Krai, invisible to ordinary eyes. Legend and ancient notes place the first Seelie, Koitar, wife of Anacharsis, here after the Heavenly Principles wiped her memory. The Traveler and the Seelie of the lake break its barrier and restore it in the world quest Echoes of a Forsaken Song.

Status as of 7.1: Revealed and restored, and open to explore as of 7.1. No later story has revisited it.

67.content:
Sanctum of Departed Heroes (also: Hall of Resounding Valor): The Sanctum of Departed Heroes is the final resting place of many Lightkeepers who died in battle, at Kipumaki Cliff in Ashveil Peak, Nod-Krai. It was once a hotspot of Wild Hunt activity. Its viewpoint is named the Hall of Resounding Valor.

Status as of 7.1: As of 7.1 the Sanctum is open to exploration; the wiki describes it as having once been a Wild Hunt hotspot.

68.content:
Sanctum of the Oathbearer (also: Court of the First Edict, Lies of the Faithless): The Sanctum of the Oathbearer, also called the Court of the First Edict, is a sealed ceremonial sanctum of the Frostmoon Scions on Hiisi Island. Until five hundred years ago the Scions held their rites here. After Aila learned of Lovia's treachery and killed her, she sealed the order's ancient documents and the evidence of Lovia's corruption inside, to stop any later leader from rising as Lovia did. It is reopened in the world quest Echoes of an Unfinished Past.

Status as of 7.1: As of 7.1 the Sanctum of the Oathbearer is unsealed and open to exploration.

69.content:
Sanctum of the Oathkeeper: The Sanctum of the Oathkeeper is an exterior area on Hiisi Island in Nod-Krai. It provides access to two instanced locations: the Sanctum of the Oathbearer and the Interstice of the Nearing Moon.

Status as of 7.1: As of 7.1 the area is open and serves as the entrance to the Oathbearer and the Interstice.

key: Knights of Favonius meeting place in Nod-Krai
70.content: Secret Base (also: "Secret Base", the secret base, Knights of Favonius meeting place in Nod-Krai): The Secret Base is a well-hidden underground meeting place on Lempo Isle in Nod-Krai. Grand Master Varka describes it as the Knights of Favonius's meeting place in Nod-Krai and a contact hub for the Northern Intelligence Network, the continent's black market of information. Only story quests open its interior: the allies of Song of the Welkin Moon gather there to plan against the Wild Hunt and its master, Rerir.

71.content:
Silvermoon Hall (also: Moon-Bathed Courtyard, Silvermoon Courtyard): Silvermoon Hall is a moon-themed cavern on Hiisi Island in Nod-Krai, the hiding place of Columbina after she left the Fatui. The player first enters it during Reunion Beneath the Moonlight, in the Archon Quest chapter Song of the Welkin Moon. While inside, only the Traveler can be controlled and Co-Op Mode is disabled.

Status as of 7.1: As of 7.1 the Hall remains Columbina's hiding place and is visited through the Selenic Chronicles quests.

72.content: Skymount: Skymount is a huge elevator that connects Ungien's Circle, the Frost Moon's biosphere, to the Space Lifeform Capture Station in space above it.

73.content:
South Harbor: The South Harbor is a harbor of the Kuuvahki Experimental Design Bureau on Paha Isle, Nod-Krai. A notice at the North Harbor routes all goods entering the Bureau through it.

Status as of 7.1: In use as of 7.1; it carries the Bureau's freight while the North Harbor stays closed.

74.content:
Southern Isles (also: Lempo Isles, Three Southern Isles): The Southern Isles, also called the Lempo Isles, are a group of three islands at the south of Nod-Krai, lying south of Pohjola: Lempo Isle, Hiisi Island and Paha Isle. Together with the city of Piramida they are the most populated part of Nod-Krai. Lempo Isle holds Nasha Town and the inventors' workshops, Hiisi Island is the wild home of the Frostmoon Scions, and Paha Isle is the Fatui's staging ground.

Status as of 7.1: As of 7.1 the islands are open and inhabited. Hiisi Island's moon cult and Paha Isle's Fatui bureau are the two forces that most affect events.

75.content:
Space Lifeform Capture Station (also: Capture Station, Skymount destination): The Space Lifeform Capture Station is a dragon-built space station floating above Ungien's Circle on the Frost Moon. The researcher Ungien made it to capture or contact the alien creatures he believed lived among the stars, so as to prove his belief that the deep-space signal came from such a being. A huge elevator called the Skymount carries visitors up from the moon to reach it.

Status as of 7.1: As of 7.1 the station is damaged but intact and open to visitors via the Skymount.

key: Dottore's lab in the far north
76.content:
Special Territory Research Institute (also: Dottore's lab in the far north): The Special Territory Research Institute is a Fatui research facility on Ashveil Peak, in the far north of Nod-Krai. It is Dottore's base during Song of the Welkin Moon, and secrets lie deep beneath its foundations. After the story it becomes the False Moon Institute, a domain where players can replay the fight with the Heretic of the False Moon.

Status as of 7.1: As of 7.1 the Institute is a replayable domain, and the story treats the moon as returned to its place in the sky.

77.content:
Speranza (also: Speranza restaurant, Katya's eatery): Speranza is the reasonably priced restaurant that retired bounty hunter Katya runs in Nasha Town, Nod-Krai. It is the main eatery of the region, popular with ordinary residents and treasure hunters, and the Conch Gang, the young staff and strays Katya looks after, treat it as their home base.

People: Katya, the Boss of Speranza, and the Conch Gang children work here.

Status as of 7.1: As of 7.1 Speranza is open, still run by Katya, and still the Conch Gang's base.

78.content:
Starsand Shoal: Starsand Shoal is the western beach of Lempo Isle in Nod-Krai. The wiki records it as the place where the spaceship of the Traveler and their sibling landed. Its expedition description says that when a dark disaster engulfed Nod-Krai many heroes made their last stand on these sands, and that the whispering waves still sing of their valor.

Status as of 7.1: As of 7.1 it remains an open beach on Lempo Isle's west coast, with Lightkeeper stones holding the Wild Hunt at bay.

79.content:
Thunderclap Reef: Thunderclap Reef is a rocky reef in the southwest of Hiisi Island, Nod-Krai. Its kuuvahki has been unstable since at least 500 years ago, giving it a strong kuuvahki environment, and the Frostmoon Scions treat it as a forbidden place. Two large Moon Fragments fell there recently and made things worse.

Status as of 7.1: As of 7.1 the reef's kuuvahki is partly stabilised but still strong, and rain is constant.

80.content: Traveler's Crater (also: Wayfarer's Crater): Traveler's Crater is the huge crater on the Frost Moon in whose centre the Traveler's spaceship rests. Columbina led the Traveler here in Welkin Moon's Homecoming (6.3), when it was a quest-only location, and from the Moon Gazing quests (6.7) it can be visited freely. Teyvat hangs in the sky above it.

81.content: Underground Energy Generation Station: The Underground Energy Generation Station is one of three stations that generate energy for the Eye of Ibni-Belum on the Frost Moon. It makes Ancient Moon Pearls, spheres that store and transport Archaeolune Energy.

82.content:
Underground Research Center (also: Secret Research): The Underground Research Center is a classified Fatui research site below the Kuuvahki Experimental Design Bureau on Paha Isle in Nod-Krai. It holds experiments on kuuvahki, the lunar energy, and collects data from three surface hubs to study how to generate high-density energy barriers.

Status as of 7.1: As of 7.1 it remains a Fatui research facility; the quest's results were never revealed.

83.content: Ungien's Circle (also: Ungien Biosphere, Sanctuary of Life, Bad-Uru-Namu-Ungien's biosphere): Ungien's Circle is a living biosphere built on the Frost Moon by the dragon life scientist Bad-Uru-Namu-Ungien. Seen from space it is a yellowed crater, and inside it plants, creatures and the kuuhenki thrive while the rest of the moon is barren and storm-lashed. It was a home for living beings on the moon, and it is where the Traveler and Eggie learn what became of Ungien (Visitors From the Stars, 6.7).

84.content:
Vesnici Proleca Greenhouse: The Vesnici Proleca Greenhouse is a flower shop in Nasha Town, Nod-Krai, run by Richeza.

Status as of 7.1: Operating as of 7.1; no change recorded.

85.content:
Voidsea Outlook: Voidsea Outlook is the area at the southern end of Pohjola, the large northern island of Nod-Krai, north of Paha Isle (added in 6.3). It holds Piramida, the mountain city that is the headquarters of the Lightkeepers, and Dreadshade Mire, a fog-choked swamp where an ancient Abyssal evil is sealed behind three stone pillars.

Status as of 7.1: As of 7.1 the area is open; the Serpent of All Evils has been defeated in the world quest, and Piramida remains the Lightkeepers' stronghold.

86.content:
Wavechaser Plain: Wavechaser Plain is the central, coastal plain of Pohjola, the large island of northern Nod-Krai (added in 6.3). It holds the Pillar of Embla, a tower that the scholar Rotwang built to break the sky, the Knights of Favonius outpost Favonius Keep, the lake Amsvartnir and the barrier islands of the Wing of Keres.

Status as of 7.1: As of 7.1 the plain is open to explore; the Pillar of Embla has been cleansed and the Knights' camp remains.

87.content:
Wing of Keres: Wing of Keres is the name for the barrier islands on the western side of Wavechaser Plain in Nod-Krai. They are decorated with Verdant Crests and other artifacts of the Frostmoon Scions. A buried time capsule written by Hyperborean engineers is the main thing to find there.

Status as of 7.1: As of 7.1 the islands are an unpopulated exploration site; the time capsule has been unearthed.

88.content: The Witch's Garden (also: Witch's Garden, Wonderland in the Rabbit Hole): The Witch's Garden is a garden point of interest in Voidsea Outlook, Nod-Krai, introduced in version 6.3. It holds the Witch's Lodge, one of the secret homes of the Hexenzirkel mage Nicole, and has a Meeting Point of the same name beside a statue before the bridge. Its map description stresses that the garden's sculptures are ordinary and hold no time-stopping magic.

89.content:
Witch's Lodge (also: Mage's lodge, Nicole's lodge): The Witch's Lodge is a secret home of Nicole, an angel and member of the Hexenzirkel, tucked away in The Witch's Garden in Nod-Krai's Voidsea Outlook. Legend says it holds vast riches that only a mind as sharp as the witch's can find. The Traveler enters it room by room through Nicole's world quests.

Status as of 7.1: As of 7.1 the lodge is a furnished retreat that Nicole shares with the Traveler; she may be away at other homes.
